ai_overview: Three steps: apply online (emrs.ehawaii.gov), meet licence agent together in person within 30 days of ceremony, ceremony by state-licensed officiant; no residency, no waiting period, no witnesses required; certificate mailed later. Cites health.hawaii.gov plus officiant/planner sites.
